frozen_hypotheses.rule: Use the unchanged incumbent cross-asset relative-momentum target only when the lagged 756-session SPY return is positive and lagged 252-session annualized realized volatility is no greater than lagged 756-session annualized realized volatility; otherwise hold SHY.

Use the unchanged incumbent cross-asset relative-momentum target except during a causal hazard defined by a recent 10-session SPY loss of at least 8%, three rising closes, SPY above its 10-session mean, and improving 50-session sector breadth; hold SHY during the hazard.
At each monthly decision, give every frozen cross-asset ETF a fixed equal slot when its lagged 252-session total return is positive and leave inactive slots in SHY.
Evaluate the existing QUAL ETF buy-and-hold path by the frozen causal market conditions. Do not label this long-only ETF proxy as the academic long-short Quality Minus Junk factor.

market_condition_diagnostics.cross_asset_directional_magnitude_defini: Mean absolute lagged 252-session total return across every member of the exact frozen roster; unavailable when any member lacks the full lookback.
market_condition_diagnostics.cross_asset_correlation_definition: Mean pairwise correlation of lagged 60-session daily returns across every member of the exact frozen roster; unavailable when any member lacks the full lookback.
market_condition_diagnostics.causality: Every label assigned to session t uses closes and breadth available through session t-1.
